name: TMGMT Google Cloud
description: A TMGMT translator using the Google Cloud Translate service.
project_description:

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 
 Google Translate translator plugin for the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) project. Allows to use machine translation provided by Google to translate content.

 Similar to TMGMT Translator Google module, but can translate more text (currently up to 200kb)

 Requirements 

Depends on Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) . Registration on http://www.google.com is required to use this module.
